description: Dataform is a framework for managing SQL based data operations in BigQuery

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(core): avoid mutating Struct inputs and fix YAML config mapping by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2463
* Install all lockfile packages from the CI registry in Cloud Build tests by @mbiernacik in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2466
* Split Exit Gate trigger from Cloud Build npm publish for SLSA provenance by @apilaskowski in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2449
* Execute dynamic DML inside onSchemaChange procedure (#2307) by @apilaskowski in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2320
* fix(cli): match column descriptors by exact path when setting BigQuery metadata by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2484
* fix(core)!: handle __proto__ keys in Structs and tighten proto checks by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2482
* chore: bump DF_VERSION from 3.1.7 to 3.1.8 by @apilaskowski in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2485


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/compare/3.1.7...3.1.8
